name: Adipiplon
summary: Adipiplon (developmental code name NG2-73) is an anxiolytic drug developed by Neurogen Corporation. It has similar effects to benzodiazepine drugs, but is structurally distinct and classed as a nonbenzodiazepine anxiolytic. Adipiplon is a subtype-selective GABAA receptor partial agonist, which binds preferentially to the α3 subtype.

pharmacology.text: Adipiplon is a subtype-selective GABAA receptor partial agonist, which binds preferentially to the α3 subtype.

uses.text: Adipiplon (developmental code name NG2-73) is an anxiolytic drug developed by Neurogen Corporation. Adipiplon was being researched as a potential medication for the treatment of anxiety and insomnia, and in 2008 it was being used in Phase IIb trials.
